data.title: 莲华 · 屏风暗处的热气纠缠
data.description: 更衣间绘有百鬼夜行的屏风背后，潮湿的浴衣被撩至腰腹。莲华被反扣着双手抵在温热的木屏上，纤细的小腿紧紧缠上对方的腰身，任由最深沉的爱欲将彼此彻底吞没。
data.location: shadow behind antique lacquered folding screen inside steamy cedar bathhouse
data.action: pinned against painted folding screen with yukata bunched high, legs wrapped tightly around partner hips, panting into the hot misty air
data.lighting: dim steamy glow from warm onsen lanterns filtering through cedar lattice
data.mood: steamy breathless abandon, primal traditional intimacy, unreserved lovers union
data.promptProse: Pinned against an antique Japanese screen in bathhouse steam, Renge wraps her legs around partner in frantic, breathless abandonment.
data.animaCaption: Renge pinned against an ornate screen in the onsen steam, lost in passionate ecstasy.
